name: The men of Cozeba
title: A clan among the descendants of Shelah
summary: The men of Cozeba were a clan descended from Shelah, Judah's son, mentioned in the genealogy along with Joash and Seraf.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: The men of Cozeba are listed among the descendants of Shelah in the tribe of Judah.
